scientific.integrity: The source Option-II update is reconstructed exactly on a deterministic two-client scalar quadratic family. The round map is derived symbolically; Schur stability is proved with the three Jury inequalities, and the unstable-client witness is exact rational arithmetic.
limitations: Two scalar clients with a common minimizer.
Deterministic exact gradients, full participation, server step eta_g=1, and Option II.
The local-contraction condition is sufficient, not a complete classification of the larger stable region.
No claim for stochastic, partially participating, or higher-dimensional coupled-Hessian SCAFFOLD.

title: Two-client SCAFFOLD can stabilize a locally divergent client
